messages:
nina_finance: Quick heads-up  EpiCore's renewal (INV-9812) didn't clear this morning. PayBridge (their 3rd-party biller) submitted ACH but our bank returned 'routing mismatch (ACCT_ROUTING)'. Auto-debit attempted at 09:05 and failed. Card on file is expired. Need fallback & short-term access plan.
rachel_support: Customer says PayBridge shows funds debited on their side and provided a trace id: PB-TRC-33421. They want to know if we can accept the trace as proof and provisionally renew access while funds settle.
tom_sales: EpiCore is enterprise + multi-product. Sales asks for a 48-72h hold if we can do provisional access. I'll confirm with Legal about risk for provisional unlock.
dylan_ops: We can set invoice to 'pending payment (provisional access)' in the billing dashboard and pause dunning. I can flip that flag if Finance approves.
nina_finance: Proposal: (1) Ask PayBridge/EpiCore for ACH trace and remittance PDF; (2) Provide wire fallback details and request PayBridge submit wire if ACH intermediaries are failing; (3) Allow provisional access for up to 72h once we receive trace, and require GL memo 'provisional credit - INV-9812' when reconciled. Also require PO# on remittance for matching.
rachel_support: Draft outgoing to customer below  please review: 
```
Hi EpiCore / PayBridge team,

Thanks for the trace id. To help us reconcile quickly please:

- Reply with the ACH trace id and a remittance PDF or bank confirmation.
- If possible, initiate a same-day wire to avoid intermediary routing issues (wire details below).
- Include your PO number or invoice reference in the payment reference field.

Wire details (placeholder):
Bank: Redwood Community Bank
Account name: Redwood Inference (Finance Ops)
Account number: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX
Routing: XXXXXX
Reference: INV-9812 / PB-TRC-33421

Once we receive the trace and/or wire confirmation we can provisionally restore access for up to 72 hours while Treasury clears funds. If you choose wire, please reply with the payment confirmation PDF.

Upload docs here: https://pay.redwood.example/upload

Thanks,
Redwood Billing
```
nina_finance: Looks good. Add a sentence: "If we receive a valid trace and remittance before close of business today, we will provisionally restore access immediately." Also log the failed ACH code and PayBridge trace in invoice notes.
payments-bot: Auto-retry blocked: card expired and ACH returned ACCT_ROUTING. Manual retry window opened for 72 hours from 1780123456. If no trace or wire received, invoice will enter standard dunning after the window.
finance-ops-bot: Treasury note: payments from third-party billers flagged as 'third-party clearing' require treasury reconciliation; please attach remittance and trace to the invoice for matching.
tom_sales: I'll call their billing contact now and escalate the wire option. Please set the provisional flag, @dylan_ops.
dylan_ops: Setting invoice INV-9812 to 'pending payment (provisional access)' and pausing automated collections. Done.
rachel_support: Message sent to EpiCore + PayBridge, included upload link and requested trace + remittance.
nina_finance: Thanks team  once we have the trace I'll coordinate GL memo and final reconciliation. Keep me posted on wire confirmation.
